That‟s Van Alexander‟s remark when he gets a senior moment. He says, “When do you have to know?”

Okay. If it‟s not something that‟s currently on your mind, then I‟ll start with a couple of things that I felt that should be included in the chronology, and that is the composition Quartet, for Shelly Manne‟s quintet, written in 1956, or at least recorded in 1956. This is quite an adventurous piece. It‟s written in four movements. Maybe you could talk about the inspiration and the writing of that particular work.
